scope: Current main branches and targeted Library title/content searches; not a claim that no other originals exist.
production_requirements: Create/revise each single separately; never crop team artwork as a finished portrait.
Preserve approved chibi paper-bag design, consistent bag scale and eye placement; retain basketball height/build differences.

Transparent full-body PNG master with intact hands, feet, props and genuine alpha; no baked checkerboard. Proposed working canvas 1536x2048, subject inside 8% safety margin; dimensions are production proposal, not prior approval.
No card frame or dialogue in portrait master. Lay out card text separately after individual image approval.
Only original DZ/PAPERBAG marks. No crowns or third-party marks.
Keep leading zeros in 01, 02 and 07. Number 23 is reserved for Ace, a Black player.
Do not set portrait_image until identity, number, likeness, alpha/edges and individual approval have been verified.

characters.personality: A perfectionist who trusts his control, then overthinks the next pitch. A-Bu is the one teammate who calls him out.
characters.review_findings: Prior single artwork lacks current DZ/PAPERBAG branding and differs in head proportions; revise against team reference.

characters.proposed_pose: Lifted-knee pitching preparation; keep ball and glove fully visible.

characters.personality: A stocky power hitter with unwavering confidence. Even after a swing and a miss, he believes the next one is leaving the park.
characters.review_findings: Prior single artwork lacks current helmet DZ crest and chest PAPERBAG branding; verify head/eye proportions.

characters.proposed_pose: Bat resting over shoulder; confident broad stance.

characters.personality: The calmest voice on the field. He handles pitches and personalities, especially when A-Zhun keeps shaking off his signs.

characters.proposed_pose: Crouch, present mitt and give a readable pitch-selection sign with the free hand; only two hands.

characters.quote_en: That was a pass. You were supposed to move.

characters.proposed_pose: Low dribble and directional free hand; preserve shortest relative height.
